findings.fix: Change the color to a darker value, such as #555555 or #000000.
findings.violation: Gray text (#999999) has insufficient contrast (~1.7:1) against white background, violating WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text).

findings.evidence: "Local residents can check real time arrivals through the mobile app. A confirmation message follows once the request is processed."
findings.fix: Remove the second sentence or replace it with text that actually describes a request-based action.
findings.violation: The text is contradictory - viewing real-time arrivals is a view-only action and does not require processing a request.
